criteria.requirement: Africans; the Foundation says it selects entrepreneurs across all 54 African countries, a complete set that includes the DRC.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, one of the 54 African countries.
criteria.quote: TEF looks out for and selects entrepreneurs with the most innovative, high potential business ideas across all 54 African countries.

criteria.requirement: Applicants must reside in Africa and plan to establish their business in Africa.
criteria.applicant: Resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Applications from Africans who reside in Africa and plan to establish their business in Africa.

criteria.applicant: Recorded only as under 30; exact age not recorded.
criteria.missing: Exact age (the profile records only the under-30 band; the minimum is 18).
criteria.quote: Applications from Africans who are 18 years and above.

criteria.requirement: A business idea or a business no older than 5 years to apply; a registered, tax-registered business with a business bank account before the seed capital is paid.
criteria.applicant: No registered business recorded; whether there is a business idea is not recorded.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant has a business idea, and whether a business would be registered (with tax registration and a business bank account) by the seed capital phase.
criteria.quote: Applications from applicants who either have a business idea or have a business no older than 5 years.

criteria.requirement: Applicants must never have benefited from any earlier TEF programme.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant has benefited from an earlier TEF programme (not recorded).
criteria.quote: Applications from applicants who have never benefitted from any of our previous programmes.

funding.conditions: Selected participants get TEF's business management training, a mentor and coaching sessions; the pages read mention no fee.
funding.quote: Training Phase: access to TEF training, pairing with mentors, and coaching sessions

funding.conditions: Non-refundable seed capital paid into the business bank account, only to participants who complete the training and investment-readiness phases and whose documents (business registration certificate, tax registration, bank reference letter) are endorsed.
funding.quote: Programme Participants whose documents are endorsed will be deemed eligible to receive their $5,000 non-refundable seed capital and will be notified.

out_of_pocket: Unknown: no fee is stated on the pages read; registering a business and opening a business bank account before the seed capital is paid may cost money (amounts not stated).

cycles.window_text: The organiser's yearly rule: the portal opens on 1 January and closes at midnight on 1 March, on TEFConnect. No 2027-specific announcement was found on the pages read.
cycles.quote: Every year, the application portal for our flagship TEF Entrepreneurship Programme opens on the 1st of January till midnight on the 1st of March at Midnight
